description: SYNTHETIC (issue #4136): written by hand, not captured live — the FamilySearch session had expired. The NARA M246 title is real; the film note, image group 008246133, image ids and roll contents are invented for the no-project test. Any other page of image group 008246133: another company's roll in Stark's brigade, so stepping through the film looks like a real M246 film. Order it after the page-specific M246 fixtures and before image-transcribe-any.

response.transcription:
A Muster and Pay Roll of a Company of New Hampshire Militia in the Brigade commanded by Brig. Gen. John Stark, 1777 (not Capt. Dustin's Company).

Names | Rank | Time of Enlistment | Time of Discharge
Ebenezer Carleton | Captain | July 18, 1777 | Sept. 24, 1777
Isaac Bayley | Lieutenant | July 18, 1777 | Sept. 24, 1777
Moody Morse | Private | July 19, 1777 | Sept. 24, 1777
